doc.name: The Korean Today (코리안투데이)
doc.instructions: The Korean Today (코리안투데이) is a Korean news outlet (registered Seoul, 아02872, since 2013). Articles are written in Korean; 15 language editions publish their own articles, and 87 languages have AI summaries of Korean articles. Read-only. Each article result includes its title, date, URL and a ready-made cite_as line. Members-only articles return metadata only.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.title: Search articles
tools.description: Full-text search of The Korean Today articles, newest first. Korean keywords work best for the Korean edition; use lang for another edition or to get translated summaries.

lang.description: Language code. Edition codes (own articles): ko, en, fr, zh, ja, vi, th, id, lo, es, pt, ar, de, mn, ru. Any of the 87 AI summary languages (e.g. vi, th, hi, sw, zh-CN, pt-BR) returns Korean articles with a translated title and summary. Default ko.

section.description: Section slug from list_sections (e.g. society, economy, k-culture, technology).

tools.name: krw_exchange_rates
tools.title: KRW exchange rates (public sources)
tools.description: Today's base rates in South Korean won (KRW per unit) for about 43 currencies, from public official sources only: Export-Import Bank of Korea and Bank of Korea (ECOS). Updated each Seoul business-day morning. Indicative, not for transactions. Each result includes the source page URL and an attribution line.

currencies.description: ISO codes like USD, JPY, EUR. Empty = all available.

tools.name: holidays
tools.title: Public holidays (20 countries) and exchange closures
tools.description: National public holidays for 20 countries (KR US JP CN VN TH PH ID IN DE GB FR AU CA BR MX AE SG HK TW) and closures of 9 stock exchanges (XKRX XNYS XNAS XJPX XHKG XSHG XLON XTAI XSES), computed from official calendars with python-holidays. Default window: today to +7 days (KST). Max 60 days.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. KR, US. Omit for all 20.

tools.name: open_pharmacies
tools.title: Pharmacies open on Sundays and Korean public holidays
tools.description: South Korean pharmacies registered as open on a given Sunday or Korean public holiday, by province and district, with self-reported opening hours, phone number, road address and a WIA Gil map link. Data: National Medical Center registry via data.go.kr, refreshed weekly. Lists only, with no information about medicines. Every response carries a notice that hours are self-reported and should be confirmed by phone before visiting. Without region: counts per province; with a province: counts per district; with province/district: the pharmacy list.

region.description: Province slug (seoul) or province/district (seoul/gangseo); Korean names also work (서울, 서울 강서구). Omit for nationwide counts.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a Sunday or a Korean public holiday (default: the next one, Seoul time).

lang.description: ko (default) or any other code for romanized place names.
